pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_llm_bake_quality.py:58 The suite pins a published per-criterion score that the judge never gave, filled from the overall median with no mark, so a criterion column can show a value nobody measured.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_llm_bake_quality.py:58 The blended score stands in for a criterion verdict, unmarked. Separately, judge.py:192 filters judgeable rows without r.valid, so contract-invalid outputs still reach the judge instead of being failed by the assertion gate.

pipeline/jobfit/eval/judging.py:40 The default judge is a moving alias, not a dated identifier, and test_automation_eval.py:94-99 calls it pinned. bench_cli.py:110 defaults the bench judge to the CLI's configured model. grep found no anchor-set or repeatability re-scoring. The committed bake (app/_lib/llm-quality-scores.ts:10) has fable-5 judging claude-sonnet-5 and claude-opus-5, an own-family judge.

pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_llm_bake_quality.py:94 Cost per model is taken over each arm's own served rows, valid or not. There is no both-succeeded subset, no subset count, and no unconditioned primary beside it in the baked cell, and that cell prices models on the Quality board.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_fault_eval.py:93 The per-mode roll-up keeps a deduped list of reasons, with no case count per family and no denominator of runs that could have tripped it.

pipeline/jobfit/llm/bench/bench_cli.py:184 Spend controls are realized: mock providers, a pre-run estimate, a ceiling refusal and a running stop (test_llm_bench.py:306-473). The failing sub-rule is per-cell durability: records stay in memory and are written once after the whole paid matrix, so a killed run loses its spend.
pipeline/jobfit/llm/bench/runner.py:397 Each scenario×target cell runs once, with no declared trial count, so no any-of-N or all-of-N pair can be computed for the non-deterministic bench.

pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_thresholds.py:106 Thresholds are declared once with a reason and direction, and consumers read that table. Only the gate side is realized: the bench scorecard names no single optimized metric and prints a table, not a verdict.

pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_automation_eval.py:206 Gated evals record unit identity, so an exam that changed underneath fails even at the same rate. The paid bench is weaker: its ids embed a position (scenarios.py:251) and carry no content version.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_llm_bake_quality.py:74 An unmeasured matrix cell stays empty rather than reading as a low score, and the cell aggregation rule is stated in bake_quality.py's docstring.
pipeline/jobfit/tests/test_automation_eval.py:36 Asserts the small enumerable recommendation and route decisions instead of judging the prose.
